# Proqi 0.11.0

Organize your board with optional thought names and movable separators, with
clearer mouse feedback and fixes for attachment transfers and global skill discovery.

## Breaking changes and upgrade

This release upgrades the database to schema 18 and storage protocol 17.
Migration is automatic and creates a backup before applying changes. Older
Proqi binaries cannot open the upgraded database. If startup reports older
running sessions as migration blockers, close those sessions cleanly and retry
with the updated executable. Do not delete the database or its lock files.

The owner-control protocol advances to 10. Public thought JSON adds nullable
`name` metadata, and thought listings also expose ordered, typed `items`,
including separators with `sep_` identities. Recovery exports use format 2 to
retain mixed Board items. Scripts should inspect `proqi --json capabilities`
and must not treat separators as empty thoughts.

## Highlights

- Name a thought with `Ctrl+R`, or find the action in Commands. Names appear
  above the body in compact and spacious layouts and remain separate from
  copied or submitted text. Cross-session transfers preserve them. The JSON
  CLI can set or rename a name with `thoughts rename` and remove it with
  `thoughts rename --clear`.
- Choose `Insert separator` in Commands to add a persistent visual divider.
  Select, move, drag, duplicate, delete, undo, and redo separators alongside
  thoughts. Explicit separators replace adjacent automatic dividers and never
  become part of copied or submitted prompts.
- Enabled controls now respond to pointer hover across the Board, session
  Browser, footers, and overlays. Feedback follows the current layout without
  moving keyboard focus or selection; disabled controls stay passive.
- Copying or moving attachment-bearing thoughts into an already open session
  now persists the destination correctly. This fixes the failure where the
  thought could appear in the destination UI without being saved and leave
  later edits unable to persist. Source removal still waits for destination
  durability.
- Global Agent Skills discovered from folders outside Git repositories retain
  their supported `$` and `/` invocation forms, including equivalent symlinked
  definitions shared by supported harnesses.

## Install

For an existing Homebrew installation:

```shell
brew update
brew upgrade --formula oborchers/tap/proqi
```

## Known limitations

- Hover requires mouse capture and a terminal that delivers pointer motion.
- Separator creation, movement, and deletion do not yet have public CLI
  commands. Public API and agent-skill parity remains a separate follow-up.
- Configurable footer hiding and direct Commands access from Edit are not
  included in this release.
